title: Spectacularly Optimized
description: The 2ND BEST Optimization modpack there is!
body:
# Spectacularly Optimized
This modpack is large and it combines the optimization mods that work with eachother and not against eachother.
An optimization modpack made to get you the best performance possible!
# Warning.
You will not get the same performance that I did while testing due to different devices.
### Device Specifications;
- CPU: Intel Core i5-8365u (Intel 8th Gen i5 Laptop CPU)
- Gpu: Nvidia Geforce RTX 3080 TI (eGPU setup)
- Ram: 1x8gb DDR4 2400MT/s
### Device Allocations;
- 4gb of ram.
